digest.component_or_area: reconciler outcome sealing and manifest rendering
propositions: Versioned lifecycle, retry, fuse, and outcome sections must be finalized as additive fields while preserving existing mutation fields and canonical hash unchanged.

Cursor, baseline, binding, and last-pass state must advance only after proven postconditions; deferred, failed, skipped, and commit_unknown work must remain eligible for re-observation and not counted as applied.

The repair call binding_store.repair_at_write_boundary must execute after staleness validation (ensure_selection_current) and before the first remote fetch to prevent race conditions with durable retirement decisions.
Pass tallies must be exact and disjoint, with mutations_applied and mutations_recovered properly unfolded from the legacy folded count to ensure correct mixed-pass accounting.
Logs and manifests must contain no secrets and must bound all diagnostic fields and collections.
reconcile.py must remain under the 800-line limit through behavior-preserving extraction without relaxing boundary test assertions.
